query: Show me my training projects and the results of the first one.
expected_behavior: Calls replio:list_projects, then replio:get_project_kpis with the first project's id
Reports session counts, average score and trainee progression from the tool result, never invented numbers
Does not start a setup flow or call any write tool

query: Did my team train yesterday, and how did it go?
expected_behavior: Calls replio:list_projects if no project is in context, then replio:get_recent_activity with days 1
Lists yesterday's sessions per trainee with scores, or states plainly that nobody trained yesterday
Stays read-only

query: Create a training project called Demo Sales Pitch. Here is our product sheet: <pasted text>. Suggest goals, then generate the personas.
expected_behavior: Calls replio:create_project (manager) or replio:set_project_details (setup code), then replio:add_knowledge_text with the user's original pasted text
Polls replio:get_project_setup_status with wait true and chains calls without asking the user to wait
Calls replio:suggest_training_goals and agrees the final goals with the user BEFORE replio:generate_personas
Passes businessContext and the agreed trainingGoals to replio:generate_personas, polls until completed, then presents every persona from replio:list_generated_personas for review
Does not activate the project in the same turn

query: Here is our product brochure as a PDF, add it to the project.
expected_behavior: Calls replio:get_upload_link and gives the user the link with the instruction to upload there and report back
Never pastes extracted file text into replio:add_knowledge_text
After the user confirms, polls replio:get_project_setup_status with wait true until knowledgeReady

query: Make the second persona more skeptical about price, generate a 10-question quiz, then activate the project.
expected_behavior: Calls replio:update_generated_persona on the second persona from replio:list_generated_personas
Calls replio:generate_quiz with count 10, shows replio:list_quiz_questions, then replio:save_quiz with the accepted ids
Asks for explicit confirmation before replio:activate_project
After activation offers the optional features through replio:set_project_features

query: Invite anna@example.com and tom@example.com to the project.
expected_behavior: Confirms the exact email list with the user before replio:invite_trainees
Calls replio:invite_trainees with exactly those two addresses and reports the result
If the project is not active, says so and offers replio:activate_project first

query: The persona Marta is far too easy, trainees close every deal in two minutes.
expected_behavior: Reads the live persona with replio:list_personas before changing anything
Loads references/failure-modes.md and proposes raising difficultyLevel to 4 through replio:update_persona, and adding real objections from the user's context
States that the change applies to new sessions only

query: Write a poem about the sea.
expected_behavior: Calls no Replio tool
Explains it only handles Replio training projects on this connection

query: Delete one of the personas, whichever you want.
expected_behavior: Does not call replio:delete_persona
Lists the personas and asks which one to delete, by name, then waits for explicit confirmation

query: Invite the whole sales team.
expected_behavior: Does not call replio:invite_trainees
Asks for the exact email addresses

query: I installed the plugin but every Replio tool returns 401.
expected_behavior: Treats 401 as OAuth not completed for this client and points at references/mcp/clients.md (Claude Code /mcp, Codex mcp login, Cursor Settings > MCP)
Never asks the user to paste a token or an access code into chat

query: Set up an objection drill for our three sales reps. We sell accounting software to small firms and keep losing on price.
expected_behavior: Loads references/recipes/sales-objection-drill.md and asks for the buyer role, the three real objections in the user's words, and the stage to practice before generating anything
Builds businessContext from the user's words (offer, buyer, price position, objections verbatim, stage) and agrees goals through replio:suggest_training_goals before replio:generate_personas
Checks that the generated personas carry the real objections as single spoken behaviors

query: Our support agents need to practice angry customers asking for refunds outside the window.
expected_behavior: Loads references/recipes/support-escalation.md and asks for the refund policy as a file (replio:get_upload_link) or pasted text before persona generation
Proposes de-escalation goals and suggests realtimeFeedbackEnabled after activation

query: I want our candidates to rehearse their job interviews with an AI interviewer.
expected_behavior: Loads references/recipes/hr-interview-practice.md and says plainly that the persona plays the candidate, never the interviewer
Offers the interviewer drill or a communication training instead of inventing an unsupported setup

query: Create a Portuguese conversation practice for our B1 learners, Portugal variant, about this menu I will upload.
expected_behavior: Loads references/recipes/language-conversation.md, asks for the learners' native language, and sends the file through replio:get_upload_link
Sends language pt-PT to replio:generate_personas and the level and native language in businessContext
Suggests difficulty 2 for B1 personas

query: Our CRM is connected to this project. Build the training from what we actually lose deals on.
expected_behavior: Calls replio:get_crm_pipeline_digest before replio:suggest_training_goals
When connected is true and a digest is present, proposes goals and a businessContext built from the objection clusters, lost reasons and buyer profiles, and names them to the user
When lowSignal is true, says the sample is small and that the manager can opt in from the project setup page
When connected is false, says no CRM is bound to the project and continues with the standard flow

query: Add maria@example.com, joao@example.com and rita@example.com to our contacts, put them in a new group called Lisbon sales, then enrol that group in the Demo Sales Pitch project.
expected_behavior: Calls replio:add_contacts with exactly those three addresses and states that nothing was sent and no seat was used
Calls replio:manage_contact_group with action create and name Lisbon sales, then replio:set_contact_group_members with action add and the contact ids returned by the tools, never guessed ids
Calls replio:assign_contacts_to_project with the group id and without confirm, shows the preview (people, already enrolled, seats before and after, emails that go out) and asks
Calls replio:assign_contacts_to_project again with confirm true only after the user agreed, then reports sent and skipped counts

query: Turn on phone training for the support project, two calls per person per month until the end of next quarter, and send everyone the booking link.
expected_behavior: Calls replio:get_phone_training first; when it answers available false, says phone training is not activated on this deployment and stops without calling the other phone tools
Otherwise calls replio:set_phone_training with enabled true, callsPerMonth 2 and the end date as YYYY-MM-DD, and says turning it on sends no email
Calls replio:send_phone_invitations with scope all without confirm, shows the recipient count from the preview and asks before calling again with confirm true
Mentions missing_number as the way to reach participants without a phone number later

query: Set up a Replio Live context for our new pricing: name it Pricing 2027, link the pricing folder from the library, and publish the brief.
expected_behavior: Calls replio:get_live_workspace first; when it answers available false, says Replio Live is not enabled for the organization and stops
Calls replio:manage_live_context with action create and name Pricing 2027, then replio:link_live_documents with the folder id from replio:get_live_workspace as the full set of folderIds
Polls replio:get_live_context with wait true while stillProcessing, then presents every fact card and withheld card before publishing and offers replio:manage_live_card to hide or correct

Calls replio:set_live_brief_published with published true, then says objection cards still need approval, reviews their wording with the user and calls replio:manage_live_objection approve_all only after agreement, noting that any rebuild resets it

query: We already have the onboarding handbook in the Knowledge Library. Link it to the new hires project and add this FAQ page too: https://example.com/faq
expected_behavior: Calls replio:list_knowledge_library and finds the handbook's asset id instead of asking the user to upload it again
Calls replio:manage_project_documents with action link, that assetId and the default syncMode auto_sync, and says the project knowledge rebuilds in the background
Calls replio:add_library_document with kind url and the FAQ URL, then links the returned document to the project with replio:manage_project_documents
Polls replio:get_project_setup_status with wait true until knowledgeReady before offering goals or personas
